nativeRedistributionLimitations: This inventory records wheel contents and SBOM declarations, not proof that every declared component is linked or that all applicable native notices/source obligations are satisfied.

NumPy actual binary LICENSE adds OpenBLAS BSD-3-Clause, LAPACK BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI, and GCC runtime GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1 beyond the package metadata expression. Preserve the exact bundled license texts and exception; this is not a conclusion that the application becomes GPL-licensed.
NumPy includes msvcp140 DLL; torch includes Intel OpenMP and other native DLLs. Component-level entitlement/notice mapping must be checked against the exact runtime payload before redistributing it.

hf-xet SBOM contains MPL-2.0 colored 3.1.1 and option-ext 0.2.0; retain required notices and provide their corresponding covered source when conveying an executable form. certifi is MPL-2.0; tqdm includes MPL-2.0 and MIT.

hf-xet, safetensors and tokenizers ship Rust-native components; collected top-level licenses and SBOM expressions do not replace all embedded third-party notices. tokenizers wheel has no legal text in its RECORD, so the matching official v0.23.2 Apache text is supplied as a supplement.
A future redistributed CPython or uv installation has its own license and bundled-component obligations. Neither is bundled or audited as part of these 37 packages.
